decisive_question: Does a concrete deployment realize attributable CPU or unreclaimable-memory improvement after V-C/L-S/strong RCU and ordinary R/O3 receive equal interfaces, real metadata budgets and same service requirements?
current_result: V-C retained as strongest conditional representation; no perrecord grace or stable-hit reader lock mandatory; no implementation/net-gain or exclusive method evidence.
inputs_that_can_change_judgment: new representative compatible lifecycle and full map/unmap/lookup/conflict/retirement costs, not old partial post-marker data
new specific deployable ability or representation/backend difference with primary evidence
minimal_action_if_triggered: freeze one named backend/workflow and one full-cost comparison; label models/projections; only the remaining decisive validation gets its own bounded execution contract
if_no_new_input: retain source-bound representation and explicit unknowns; no repeated protocol decomposition, same data-entry search or old threshold numbers; no automatic implementation/collection/model/experiment
fair_controls: R-S with legal batching and bounded spare nodes
dense/cookie and DMA_PMD/dma-buf when contract fits
acceptance: actual metadata bytes plus K and H/node capacities; sameK is not sameRAM
strong RCU need not hold payload until node grace
allocation and retirement feedback not fixed O0 PFN trace
no claim that ordinary reproduction closes interface/architecture family
